{{Quote|The galaxy's criminal networks wavered endlessly during the Great War, debating whether to back the Republic or the Empire. Although the Hutt Cartels resented the Sith Emperor for not including them in his pre-war conspiracy, Imperial Intelligence somehow blocked the Republic's efforts to win the Hutts' support.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 4" />}}
After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] return to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], Imperial representatives from the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]] brokered a '''treaty''' with the powerful [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. The agreement stipulated that, as the Empire grew in power and territory over the course of the Great Galactic War and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] would be allowed to maintain their sovereignty and neutrality, provided neither they nor any inferior [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] or subsidiaries worked to further the interests of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;the Empire's primary nemesis in the wars.

The treaty benefited both parties until around [[3643 BBY]], when three Hutt families violated its terms and worked alongside Republic [[Scientist/Legends|researchers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] to manufacture [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] stimulants. The Empire discovered the operation and forced the Cartel to label the three families as traitors and join the Sith in an [[Quesh war|assault]] on Quesh.

==Terms==
{{Quote|It wasn't long before the Empire heard about this vast source of chemical wealth - and the treaty-breaking Hutts. The Cartel was forced to declare the Republic-aligned Hutts traitors, and assist the Empire as it launched a full-scale attack on Quesh, seeking to destroy Republic efforts and claim the resource for its own.|A HoloNet dossier on Quesh|<ref name="Quesh" />}}
The treaty between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] created an officially-recognized status of neutrality between the Imperial government and the Cartel during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the following [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The document stipulated that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' criminal enterprises would be allowed to remain autonomous, given that the individual [[Kajidic/Legends|clans]] and subsidiaries also remained neutral. In the event that the treaty was violated and Hutt agents cooperated with the interests of the Empire's adversary, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were authorized to exert control over the Cartel and force the organization's leaders to name the specific violators as traitors.<ref name="Quesh" />

==History==
[[File:Quesh-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The planet [[Quesh]], where a number of Hutt families reneged on the treaty]]
In [[3681 BBY]], the Great Galactic War was [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|initiated]] and exploded across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] following the Sith Empire's return to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="GGW start date">According to ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', the [[Great Galactic War]] begins twenty-eight years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty was proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''.</ref> For [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, the Sith had been conspiring against their age-old enemies in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by acquiring power and territory in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and growing their mighty war machine.<ref name="Timeline 11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref> Simultaneously, Imperial agents worked to corrupt [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]],<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> buy the allegiance of localized [[Crime lord/Legends|crime bosses]] and [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]],<ref name="Sith Empire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref> and insert covert operatives into the Republic bureaucracy and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ranks.<ref name="Timeline 7">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|int=Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?}}</ref> When the war erupted and the Sith made their presence in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] known, both they and the Republic sought to curry the favor of underworld criminal organizations, particularly the Hutt Cartel.<ref name="Timeline 4" />

Despite the Cartel's consistent disregard for Republic law,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Hutts chose not to support the Empire, as they were upset that the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] had decided not to include them in his pre-war plans. Although the situation could have provided the Republic with an opportunity to form an alliance with the Cartel, [[Imperial Agent|agents]] of the Empire's [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]] managed to prevent such a scenario from happening by setting up a system of mutual neutrality between the Imperial government and the Hutts.<ref name="Timeline 4" /> The resulting treaty between the two parties allowed for the Cartel to remain neutral through the end of the Great Galactic War in [[3653 BBY]] and beyond, into the Cold War.<ref name="Quesh" />

Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TLS date">The battle for Quesh is a setting seen in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. [http://swtor.com/community/showthread.php?p=5365704#edit5365704 This forum post] from ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]], indicates that the game takes place ten years after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], placing the conflict over Quesh around [[3643 BBY]].</ref> three Hutt families violated the terms of the treaty and agreed to assist Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on the planet [[Quesh]] in their attempts to synthesize [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] stimulants for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. Upon learning of the violation, the Sith Empire forced the Cartel to brand the three families as traitors and join in an [[Quesh war|attack on Quesh]] to root out the Republic agents and seize the world's rich chemical resources.<ref name="Quesh" /> [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] later included a mention of the Ministry of Intelligence's accord with the Hutts in [[Galactic Timeline (in-universe)|his efforts]] to chronicle the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Timeline 4" />

==Reception==
{{Quote|Ultimately though, Republic engineers were unable to master the techniques to synthesize the adrenals. They were forced to seek help from some unlikely allies– the Hutts. Three families from the Hutt Cartel were quietly convinced to step around their neutrality treaty with the Empire in return for a cut of adrenal profits that not even a Hutt could refuse. The Cartel, so long as they received their share, looked the other way.|A HoloNet dossier on Quesh|<ref name="Quesh" />}}
The Hutt&ndash;Imperial treaty was widely obeyed by both parties through the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Quesh" /> Even in light of the Hutts' resentment of the Sith Emperor, they made no significant move to assist the enemy's forces, despite the overtures of Republic agents.<ref name="Timeline 4" /> The promise of sovereignty kept the Cartel's constituent clans in line until the Cold War, when Republic researchers were able to sway three Kajidics to violate the terms in return for a cut of the profits from adrenal stimulants produced on Quesh,<ref name="Quesh" /> a world within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Galaxy Map">{{HolonetOld|galaxy-map||Galaxy Map}}</ref>

The rest of the Cartel knew of the betrayal, but the profit-minded Hutts agreed not to enforce the treaty so long as the violating Kajidics and the Republic ensured payment of a steady tribute of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the larger organization. When the Empire learned of the activities on Quesh, the Cartel reluctantly declared the Republic-allied Hutts traitors and unhappily entered into a military alliance with the Sith.<ref name="Quesh" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt&ndash;Imperial treaty was created as part of the setting for the upcoming [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The accord was first alluded to in the fourth entry of the [[Galactic Timeline]], titled [[Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|''The Empire Changes Strategy'']]. The Timeline is a series of [[in-universe]] video entries voiced by actor [[Lance Henriksen]], available on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} [http://www.swtor.com official website]. The treaty was explicitly mentioned for the first time on the [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet/planets/quesh Quesh information page], found on [[The Holonet]], an online database for information on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} setting, also available on the official site.
